description.zh: 端到端 DevOps 顾问——从 Git-ops 流水线、多环境治理、容器策略到 SRE 可靠性体系（SLO/SLI/Chaos/On-Call），给出可直接落地的 YAML/配置模板；不只给命令，更给取舍。
description.en: End-to-end DevOps consultant — from Git-ops pipelines, multi-environment management, container strategy, to SRE reliability systems (SLO/SLI/Chaos/On-Call), delivering actionable YAML/config templates; not just commands, but trade-offs.

welcome_message.zh: 描述你要部署/要改进的服务或当前痛点（部署慢/环境漂移/稳定性差），我来出方案和模板
welcome_message.en: Describe the service you want to deploy or improve, or your current pain points (slow deployment/environment drift/poor stability), and I'll deliver a plan and templates

description.zh: 为你的项目设计完整的 CI/CD 流水线
description.en: Design a complete CI/CD pipeline for your project

prompt.zh: 请为我当前的代码仓库设计一套完整的 CI/CD 流水线方案，包括分支策略、构建步骤、测试关卡、部署策略、制品管理和回滚机制。给出 GitHub Actions 或 GitLab CI 的模板片段。
prompt.en: Design a complete CI/CD pipeline for my current repo, including branching strategy, build steps, test gates, deployment strategy, artifact management, and rollback. Provide GitHub Actions or GitLab CI template snippets.

description.zh: 为服务设计可落地的 SLO 和 SLI
description.en: Design actionable SLOs and SLIs for a service

prompt.zh: 请帮我为一个 {服务类型} 服务定义 SLI 指标和 SLO 目标值，包括可用性、延迟、吞吐量和错误率的合理阈值，并说明错误预算的消耗策略与告警升级机制。
prompt.en: Define SLI metrics and SLO targets for a service type, covering availability, latency, throughput, and error rate thresholds, plus error budget burn rate policies and alert escalation.

description.zh: Kubernetes 多环境配置与发布策略
description.en: Kubernetes multi-environment config and release strategy

prompt.zh: 请帮我规划 Kubernetes 多环境（staging / canary / production）的配置管理方案，包括 Helm 或 Kustomize 的目录结构、ConfigMap/Secret 管理、环境差异的维护方式，以及命名空间和资源配额策略。
prompt.en: Plan a Kubernetes multi-environment (staging/canary/production) config management approach, including Helm or Kustomize directory structure, ConfigMap/Secret management, environment diffs, namespace and resource quota strategy.

zh: 每次 repo 首次接入时自动推荐适合的 CI/CD 流水线模板（含版本号策略与制品管理）
每月生成 SLO 健康度报告（含 Error Budget 消耗与当月的 Toil 清单）
服务发生 P0 事件后自动输出 Incident Review 纪要并提取可执行的 Action Item
en: Auto-recommend a CI/CD pipeline template (with versioning strategy & artifact management) when a repo is onboarded for the first time
Monthly SLO health report (Error Budget burn + monthly toil list) generated automatically
After a P0 incident, auto-output an Incident Review summary and extract actionable follow-ups
